title: From the regulation

items.title: EU AI Act
items.excerpt: General-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 have until 2 August 2027 to comply.

fallback_text: From the EU AI Act, Article 111 (primary source): “General-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 have until 2 August 2027 to comply.” https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32024R1689
